answer: Admission auctions stop bulk fakes: each epoch opens a few slots, auctioned like rare jade to the highest bidders. Newcomers bid for a place in the garden, and rival bids drive the price up. Winners lock their bid for 20 epochs as a river of fresh bids sets the price; honest work keeps it, a caught fake forfeits the deposit. Forging 1,000 identities at 50 credits each costs 50,000 credits, more than fakes earn, while an honest agent pays once.
